question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**rigorous**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage describes the Enlightenment as a period marked by intense and thorough scientific, political, and philosophical discussion.
 
• The adjective should reflect the nature of debate being detailed, which is precise, strict, and demanding, hence “rigorous”.
 
• **“Rigorous” (****कठिन****)** means extremely thorough, exhaustive, or accurate, which fits well with the idea of serious intellectual debate.
 
• Other options such as “auspicious” (शुभ), “malicious” (दुष्ट), and “cautious” (सावधान) do not match the context of describing the nature of the Enlightenment debates.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The Enlightenment, sometimes known as the ‘Age of Reason’, is described as the period of 1. rigorous__ scientific, political, and philosophical debate that characterised European culture (2) ________ the ‘long’ 18th century: from the late 17th century until the end of the Napoleonic Wars in 1815. This was an era of an enormous (3) ________ in thinking and reason, which historian Roy Porter describes as ‘decisive in the formation of modernity’. Centuries of custom and tradition were (4) ________ in favour of exploration, individuality, tolerance, and scientific (5) ________, all of which contributed to the formation of the ‘modern world’.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Auspicious (शुभ):** Means favorable or conducive to success.
 
• **Malicious (दुष्ट):** Means intending to do harm.
 
• **Cautious (सावधान): **Means being careful to avoid danger.
